newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 750 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 750 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 750 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 41 wheat contracts, 261 corn, 414 soybean, 9 soymeal, 20 soyoil and 5 oats futures contracts traded, along with 3 soybean call options.

The overnight trend for corn was one cent per bushel lower to 3/4 cent higher, soybeans were up 2 to 2-1/2 cents, wheat unchanged to up 1/4 cent, soymeal unchanged to up 80 cents a ton, soyoil unchanged to up 0.03 cent per lb, and oats down one cent per bushel.
